seo.title: Melusina Architecture | Isolation, Multi-Key Security & Verifiability
seo.description: See how Melusina isolates every app in its own container, splits administrative control across multiple keyholders, and anchors everything to cryptographic proof — not vendor promises.
seo.keywords: Melusina architecture, NFT licensing, threshold cryptography, Shamir secret sharing, DANE, Pearl isolation, Solana, capability security

heading: How Melusina keeps every instance isolated, every connection controlled, and everything provable
subtitle: Four architectural pillars. Each one removes something you'd normally have to take on faith — from vendor promises to admin access to data boundaries.

pillars.title: NFT Trust Hierarchy
pillars.subtitle: Your license lives on the blockchain — anyone can check it
pillars.detail: Foundation → Reseller → License → Shares. Every privileged operation requires on-chain proof. License NFTs are domain-bound with configurable keyholders. TrustMaster lets any third party verify your entire trust chain independently — without contacting your server.

pillars.title: Multi-Keyholder Approval
pillars.subtitle: No single person can compromise the system
pillars.detail: M-of-N keyholder approval for every critical operation. Real Shamir secret sharing over GF(256) with Lagrange interpolation. Per-keyholder shares encrypted via NaCl SealedBox to X25519 public keys. 44 unit tests verify the implementation.

pillars.title: Derived Ephemeral Keys
pillars.subtitle: Nothing to steal because nothing is stored
pillars.detail: CA private keys are deterministically derived from license NFT + domain + keyholder public keys. Used once to sign certificates, then destroyed. Vault unseal keys come from keyholder approvals. Key management without key storage.

pillars.title: Pearl Isolation
pillars.subtitle: Every spreadsheet, photo, wallet, and chat in its own container
pillars.detail: Every spreadsheet, photo album, chat room, wallet, and document runs in its own Pearl with separate storage and process space. Random hostnames enforce browser same-origin isolation. Access controlled via Grapple — this Bureau spreadsheet can talk to that AI Lagoon model, but only if you approve it. Bureau alone packages four Pearl types — spreadsheet, document, diagram, image editor — each running as an isolated Pearl with its own data store and permissions.

securityThemes.label: TLS That Anyone Can Verify
securityThemes.detail: External TLS certificates are pinned in DNSSEC-signed DNS via TLSA records — any third party can verify the TLS binding by querying DNS. Internally, all container-to-container communication uses mutual TLS via an internal CA whose keys come from the keyholder ceremony. No unencrypted traffic between containers. Man-in-the-middle is impossible at both layers.

securityThemes.label: Nothing Starts Without Verification
securityThemes.detail: 4-phase boot: verify License NFT on Solana → start monitoring (age-encrypted bootstrap secrets) → keyholder approval to unseal Vault → start services. Graceful degradation when Solana is offline.

securityThemes.label: Admin Access You Can Revoke in One Block
securityThemes.detail: Admin authority is a Solana NFT. The license holder can freeze or recall it instantly. Revocation is immediate — no database coordination. Full on-chain audit trail of when admin was granted, frozen, or revoked.

securityThemes.label: Immutable Audit Trail
securityThemes.detail: Every vault access, backup hash, certificate rotation, and keyholder approval is recorded as a Solana Memo transaction. Immutable. Verifiable by any third party.

securityThemes.label: Grapple: Universal App Composition
securityThemes.detail: Pearls request specific capabilities from other Pearls via Grapple — Melusina's universal connector. AI Lagoon defines three capability types (AIText, AIVision, AIGeneric) and offers them via Grapple's matchOffers system. Any Pearl on the server can request AI — Grapple pops up a model picker, the user chooses, and the capability persists across restarts. CoinFace's Station and Identity Pearls communicate through custom protocols — the Station sees only anonymized status, never raw PII. BotMother defines MessageSink and MessageReceiver capabilities for bidirectional Telegram routing. Each connection is between two specific Pearls. You approve every one.

securityThemes.label: Payments Verified on the Blockchain
securityThemes.detail: Subscription payments verified on-chain via Solana getTransaction(). No payment gateways. No intermediaries. Install gate returns 402 without active subscription. All payment verification is cryptographic.

securityThemes.label: Per-Container Spending Limits
securityThemes.detail: Each Pearl has its own SOL wallet with escrow. Platform services — OTP, SMS, email, AI inference — are metered and deducted as micropayments. Operators set per-container budgets; the platform enforces them. Runaway costs are impossible.

securityThemes.label: OTP the App Never Sees
securityThemes.detail: OTP, email, SMS, and Telegram delivery are platform-level shared services. The container calls requestOtp, the platform generates a 6-digit code (stored as SHA-256 hash), emails it to the user. The user enters the code, the container calls verifyOtp and gets back an HMAC proof token — never the code itself. Rate-limited (60s cooldown, 5/hr), 3 max attempts, timing-safe comparison.

securityThemes.label: Push Notifications That Leak Nothing
securityThemes.detail: Push notifications are content-free by design — payloads contain no data ('something happened'), preventing content leakage through the browser push service. DDP-aware: pushes only fire when the user lacks an active real-time connection.

securityThemes.label: Wallet Login with Three Fallbacks
securityThemes.detail: Challenge-response Ed25519 authentication: (1) Browser extension auto-detection (Phantom, Solflare, Backpack), (2) Mobile Wallet Adapter for Android, (3) Server-rendered QR code for iOS and wallet-less devices. Keyholder NFT holders get admin access automatically with 5-minute cache. Cap'n Proto UserInfo schema carries wallet address, chain, and network.

securityThemes.label: Four Ways to Share a Link
securityThemes.detail: Pearl links carry access rights to a specific Pearl. Four modes: Burn-after-reading (consumed when the tab closes), Timed (expires at a specific datetime), Use-count (atomic counter decremented per access), and Unlimited (valid until manually revoked). For NFT-backed containers, the URL token's SHA-256 hash is stored on-chain via a Solana PDA.

securityThemes.label: Apps Can Create Other Apps (With Permission)
securityThemes.detail: Containers can create new containers via Cap'n Proto createGrain RPC — but only when admin-defined policy rules whitelist the exact app pair. The requesting container must explain why (min 25 characters). The user sees an approval popup. On approval, a share-back link is returned. No app can silently spawn instances.

securityThemes.label: Type-Safe Inter-Process Communication
securityThemes.detail: Cap'n Proto (designed by Kenton Varda, creator of Protocol Buffers) is the universal communication protocol. Every API, system call, and capability exchange uses Cap'n Proto schemas — type-safe, zero-copy, capability-based. Dual transport: native Cap'n Proto for internal calls and postMessage bridging for HTTP-sandboxed containers.

securityThemes.label: Multi-Pearl App Architecture
securityThemes.detail: Apps aren't limited to a single Pearl type. Bureau packages four Pearl types (spreadsheet, document, diagram, image editor) in one .spk. BotMother has three (bot hub, Telegram connector, chatroom engine). MerMail has four (client, instance, manager, client-UI manager). A launcher script determines which binary to run based on Pearl type. One install, multiple personalities — each fully isolated.

securityThemes.label: Dedicated Supporting Services
securityThemes.detail: Three specialized services run alongside the core platform: MerMail's email gateway (Postmark + SMTP failover, DKIM signing, SRS forwarding), Solana RPC Proxy (47 whitelisted methods with rate limiting — containers never touch raw RPC), and Cyclone (cluster scaling for multi-machine container orchestration). All communicate via internal mutual TLS.
